head: fbe0be360
summary: The whole-frame read is clearly better. On RIFT, BRIDGE and FRAY the ground now sits mid-value and calm, lanes, jungle and the violet Standing Shadow separate at a glance, and fighters out-chroma the floor. Every budget gate reproduces with headroom. The lane still does not pass: three Done-when lines do not hold (fighter value bar and units_gate, the telegraph/HARM contrast gate, and the idle frame-time A/B against wave 1). Enemy telegraph edge contrast fell on every map I measured, so the change is not 'no worse on every player-visible measure'.

doneWhen.line: perf_1080 multi-mode/tier gate: programs <= 36 every mode and tier, 0 first seen after 1:00; triangle peak <= 470k; draws <= 450
doneWhen.numbers: My own runs (seed 7 to 10:00, x4, dev build, own vite :5271). RIFT low/med/high/ultra: 270k/278k/310k/311k tris, 185/214/218/218 draws, 24/36/36/36 programs. BRIDGE: 420k/433k/437k/437k, 240/264/270/270 draws, 25/36/36/36 programs. FRAY: 178k/184k/185k/188k, 105/125/129/130 draws, 18/29/29/29 programs. 0 programs first seen after 1:00 in all 12 cases. Full RIFT High match, seed 23: peak 462k at 1787.6 s, 281 draws, 36 programs, 0 late. These match the implementer within 1k. Actors at the seed-23 profiled peak frame read 205k, not the 180k reported, and BRIDGE High actors are 285k at its peak. Both are over the Work item's 190k (not a Done-when line).

doneWhen.line: Idle A/B frame time on High 1080p no worse than wave-1 baseline + 0.5 ms
doneWhen.numbers: Not measured against wave 1. Only a same-page switch A/B exists (+0.3 ms RIFT, +0.2 ms BRIDGE, implementer's). The switches do not restore the wave-1 build, so this line is unproven.

doneWhen.line: value_probe: lane p50 L* 50-58, jungle floor 28-34, walls 24-30 on all 3 maps; telegraph dE and HARM contrast gates pass; colour-blind sheets pass
doneWhen.numbers: My value_probe run (High, seed 7, t 75): lanes 51 / 50.5 / 50, all within 1 L* of the lower edge; RIFT jungle 29.5; wall faces RIFT 28, FRAY 25, BRIDGE gorge 15.5 (outside 24-30 but under ruling 46's carve-out 14-22); fighters top-25 74.5 / 74.5 / 75.4; above L* 90 at most 0.25 %; T4 flash 2.09 / 1.89 / 2.0. BRIDGE's 1.89 is below 2.0, and ruling 46 recorded BRIDGE at 3.33 before the re-key. Colour-blind teamfight sheets (deutan, tritan, my capture): teams stay apart, so they pass by eye. Telegraph: the plan gives no numeric bar and the implementer reported no result. My own A/B (_tmp_vfy_w2a_probe.mjs, seed 11, enemy r3 circle, wave-1 = W2-A switches and teleInk off) loses edge contrast everywhere. Edge WCAG p90: RIFT lane 2.23->1.79, jungle 3.51->2.13, river 2.49->1.80; BRIDGE 3.29->2.59 and 2.06->1.78; FRAY 2.18->2.02 and 1.77->1.68. Clutter-metric teleEdge p90: RIFT lane 0.67->0.36, jungle 1.47->0.60, river 0.72->0.35; BRIDGE 1.03->0.76 and 0.44->0.31; FRAY 0.40->0.34 and 0.33->0.28. Re-running _tmp_w2a_ab rift at seed 11 gives telegraph dE p50 16.3->14.5 and edgeCR90 3.64->2.69. The implementer's own clutter scan shows the same: teleEdge 0.316 off -> 0.211 on (evidence/clutter/clutter_w2a_{off,on}.json), against W2-B's bar of 0.45.

doneWhen.line: Fighters: on-screen C >= 70 % of albedo C on signature zones, top-25 L* <= 80; units_gate still passes; Vashil lilac dE76 >= 25 holds
doneWhen.numbers: My re-run of _tmp_w2a_tone.mjs (16 fighters) gives a zone ratio min of 1.09 (pass) and zone C* min 21.8. Top-25 L* runs 67.2-81.4: Ardit is at 81.4, over 80. Burdam 67.2, Ervet 69.5 and Odrum 69.7 sit under units_gate P3's floor of 70, and units_gate does not pass (it has not passed since ruling 46; owner-accepted for UNITS2, but this line says 'still passes'). No harness measures the Vashil lilac dE76 rule, and neither the implementer nor I measured it.

doneWhen.line: Fog vs Standing Shadow dE >= 15 on display in a paired Noonline capture
doneWhen.numbers: Re-run at seed 11: Shadow lit vs fogged ground beside it, dE76 11.3 -> 20.4; Shadow fogged vs fogged ground, 10.1 -> 18.5. The 'below' patch at (85,52) reads exactly L*0 a*0 b*0 in every state, so it is off-screen or masked; ignore the dE_*_vs_fogBelow numbers.

doneWhen.line: Opus render verifier on the W1-D pack: score >= 7.5, no blocker

frames.note: All captured by this verifier at 1920x1080, High, own vite on :5271, under heavy.py, into the session scratchpad: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sitskovich-Developer-forgeflow-games/03f17c1d-60ba-4393-8820-fb1c6015dccd/scratchpad/{vp,pr,cb,gfx5}. orch1_visual_pack rift/bridge/fray/fight/cb:deutan/cb:tritan, plus _tmp_vfy_w2a_probe.mjs fight A/Bs (seed 11).

referenceTargets.note: Lanes L* 50-51 and ground saturation 0.24, with no crushed blacks. The flagstone crack pattern and the pebble/leaf scatter stay a little busy at lane level, but nothing on the floor competes with units.

referenceTargets.text: paths, river, jungle told apart at a glance
referenceTargets.note: Warm tan lane, green jungle (L* 29.5) and the violet Standing Shadow separate by hue and value. The edges are hard stone kerbs rather than soft painted ones, a deliberate design choice.

referenceTargets.text: flat readable light, small contact shadows, no black pools
referenceTargets.note: No crushed darks any more. Large tree and wall cast shadows still lay big dark bands across lanes and plates. A black wedge/crystal object with an unlit body appears in RIFT lane frames before and after (not a W2-A regression).

referenceTargets.text: chunky walls, lighter top than side
referenceTargets.note: FRAY tops 49 vs faces 25 is clear. RIFT tops 33.5 vs faces 28 is only a 5.5 L* step, and canopy often hides the top. BRIDGE's gorge reads as blocked by value.
Unseen/lit ratio 0.54 is even across classes (implementer's fog run; I did not re-run --fog). The edge softness belongs to W4-B and is not judged here.

referenceTargets.text: fighters most saturated and highest contrast
referenceTargets.note: In lane and skirmish frames the fighters clearly out-chroma the ground (zone C* >= 21.8, ratio >= 1.09), and the A/B shows dark kits lifted. At the teamfight peak the fighters are partly lost under VFX (W2-B's), Ardit is over the value bar, and three kits sit under 70.

referenceTargets.text: thin dark edge plus team-coloured segmented bar
referenceTargets.note: Ink outline on every unit; segmented blue/orange bars stay legible on the lighter ground.

referenceTargets.text: minions smaller, simpler, less saturated; team colour unmistakable
referenceTargets.note: Wicks are about 60 % of fighter height, in muted navy/brown with team-coloured trims, and keep the old crown so they sit a step below the fighters.

originality: VALE's own solution throughout: a dial-plate FRAY with roman hour marks, the violet Standing Shadow in place of a water river, Dialwood canopy light pools, lantern/glass structures, and VALE's own fighters and Wicks. No reference names, art, icons or layouts are in the W2-A diff (src/render lighting/world_material/lod/crowd/renderer/actors, tokens grade). No reference frames are stored in the repo.
blockers: The telegraph / HARM contrast Done-when line is not met. Neither the plan nor the implementer gave it a bar or a result, and my A/B shows enemy telegraph edge contrast down on every map and spot: edge WCAG p90 RIFT lane 2.23->1.79, jungle 3.51->2.13; teleEdge p90 RIFT lane 0.67->0.36, river 0.72->0.35. The implementer's clutter scan also drops, 0.316 -> 0.211, against W2-B's 0.45 bar. The brighter ground costs the safety overlay its contrast, and teleInk does not recover it. The fix belongs in W2-A's renderer.ts teleInk (or edge alpha/width by agreement with W2-B), with a recorded bar such as edgeCR90 >= wave-1 or teleEdge >= 0.45.
problems: Fighter Done-when fails: Ardit top-25 L* 81.4 (bar 80); units_gate P3 fails for burdam 67.2, ervet 69.5, odrum 69.7; Vashil lilac dE76 >= 25 has no measurement in any harness and was not reported.
Idle High frame-time A/B against the wave-1 baseline was not measured. The same-page switch A/B (+0.2-0.3 ms) is not the stated gate.
T4 flash BRIDGE 1.89x on my run (bar 2.0; 3.33 before the re-key per ruling 46). The re-key consumed the headroom; it is handed to W2-B but caused here.
Actors at the RIFT seed-23 profiled peak frame read 205k on my run, not the 180k reported; BRIDGE High actors are 265-285k at its 262 s peak. The Work item asks for <= 190k at peak.
Lanes sit at 50-51 L*, the very bottom of the 50-58 band, with no margin for map or seed variance.

Ownership: W2-A edited src/render/actors.ts (+75 lines of LOD2 hull code via wip sync a5f8cd0cc). plan.md assigns actors.ts to W2-B (death timing) and W3-B, not W2-A, and this risks collision with those lanes.

value_probe.mjs still gates the retired r12 B5 luma bands (11 FAILs on my run, all laneP50/frameP50/fighterTop25-over-lane/flash). This hides real regressions in its output, and its owner should re-key it to ruling 46.
evidence: Scratch tools: _harness/_tmp_vfy_w2a_probe.mjs (telegraph A/B and fight frames), _harness/_tmp_vfy_w2a_dbg.mjs (bench load check). Reports: _harness/_reports/vfy_w2a_value.json; perf JSONs and logs perf_{rift,bridge,fray,s23} and tone_s11.json in the session scratchpad.
